items.text: All 7 workshop decisions (4 from round 1, 3 from round 2) have been incorporated into the plan. Round 2 additions: (1) EventNotification now embeds full EventEnvelope + stream_sequence int64 for SSE Last-Event-ID resume, (2) PolicySnapshot includes version int64 + generated_at Timestamp for cache ordering during reconnection, (3) shared PolicyMatcher message extracted — AccessRule, RateLimit, and CircuitBreaker all embed PolicyMatcher instead of duplicating source_pattern/target_pattern/action_pattern.

Plan updated: Implementation Strategy phases 2 and 3 now reflect PolicyMatcher extraction (Phase 2 defines PolicyMatcher, rule types embed it), EventNotification shape (Phase 3 includes stream_sequence + envelope), and PolicySnapshot versioning (Phase 3 includes version + generated_at). Testing Plan updated with field spot-checks for all new fields. Definition of Done expanded with 3 new checkboxes covering PolicyMatcher usage, EventNotification shape, and PolicySnapshot versioning.

No remaining gaps. All message shapes, field types, enum values, directory structure, and package naming are fully specified. The plan is ready for execution. All readiness dimensions score 3/3: problem is clear (proto schemas for a well-researched architecture), scope is tight (3 files + buf generate), approach is solid (follows established agent-manager patterns with all contract decisions settled), testing is concrete (buf lint, buf generate, Go compile, output existence checks, field spot-checks), and risks are identified with mitigations.

plan_updates: Incorporated round 2 decisions: PolicyMatcher shared message, EventNotification with stream_sequence + embedded envelope, PolicySnapshot with version + generated_at. Updated Implementation Strategy phases 2-3, Testing Plan field spot-checks, Risks table (added PolicyMatcher extraction risk), and Definition of Done (3 new checkboxes). All 7 decisions from both rounds are now reflected in the plan.
